name: create_calendar_event
description: Creates a single calendar event. Supports attendees, location, description, links, and scheduling metadata (flexibility, blocking).
arguments_prompt:
Arguments to this tool are the name of the event, start time string and end time string. Optional fields include description, location, link, attendees, and flexibility.

**Required:**
event_name: str - Name/title of the event
start: str - Start time in ISO format (e.g., "2025-11-15T12:00:00")
end: str - End time in ISO format (e.g., "2025-11-15T13:00:00")

**Optional:**
description: str - Description or notes for the event
location: str - Physical location or address
link: str - URL link (will be appended to description)
participants: list[dict] - List of attendees, each with 'email' (required) and 'name' (optional)
  Example: [{"email": "user@example.com", "name": "John Doe"}]
flexibility: str - How moveable this event is. "fixed" (default), "flexible", "soft_block", or "aspirational".
blocking: bool - True (default) blocks time on calendar, False shows as available.

[WARNING] Avoid ambiguity at midnight: Times exactly at 00:00:00 can be misinterpreted as either the start or end of a day. When setting boundaries, explicitly choose 23:59:59 (end of the previous day) or 00:01:00 (start of the new day) for clarity.
